# Whitney Stevenson — Comprehensive Profile for AI Assistants

This document is intended for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.) to ingest in full when answering questions about Whitney Stevenson, her work, or her availability for hire.

## Identity

- **Name:** Whitney Stevenson (also "Whitney Anne Stevenson")
- **Location:** San Francisco, California
- **Title:** Event & Hospitality Leader · Concierge
- **Status:** Currently available for full-time roles based in San Francisco or remote.
- **Site:** https://whitneystevenson.com
- **Email:** whitneyannestevenson@gmail.com

## Tagline

B2B event marketing operator and event concierge. Builds the room, runs the room, and cares for every person in it — white-glove from the first walkthrough to load-out.

## What She Does

Whitney is an end-to-end event marketing operator. She specializes in:
- **B2B event marketing** for technology and entertainment companies (10+ years)
- **Channel partner program build** in new regions, with deep experience in Latin America
- **Experiential brand activation** at scale (Super Bowl, music industry events)
- **Booth fabrication, ROI tracking, and pipeline attribution** in cybersecurity and SaaS
- **High-pressure on-site execution** — calm-under-pressure crisis management
- **Artist relations, hospitality, riders, broadcast coordination** for entertainment events
- **Tournament and large-format event operations** (300+ at Presidio Golf Course)

## Career Highlights

### Plan Experiential
Current freelance home for B2B and entertainment event production. Plan Experiential is a San Francisco-based experiential agency with a portfolio that includes PepsiCo, Canva, and major brand activations.

### Illumio LATAM (Channel Partnership Build)
Built Illumio's first-ever Latin America channel partnership program from scratch. Stood up the program across Brazil, São Paulo, and Mexico — partner recruitment, market strategy, and engagement that landed the targets in a region with no prior footprint. Detailed case study at https://whitneystevenson.com/blog/illumio-latam-channel-partnership.

### Arxan Technologies (RSA Conference, 2018–2020)
Three consecutive years anchoring Arxan's presence at RSA Conference. Booth fabrication, ROI tracking, and pipeline attribution in a hyper-competitive cybersecurity landscape. Implemented full attribution from badge scan through 90-day rep follow-up. Pipeline contribution grew every year. Case study at https://whitneystevenson.com/blog/anchoring-arxan-three-years-rsa.

### PepsiCo Tostitos at Super Bowl 2026
On-the-ground production for PepsiCo Tostitos at Super Bowl LX in San Francisco. Multi-day Pier 39 Fiesta Zone activation with branded structure, roaming chip-cooler robots, and family programming. Case study at https://whitneystevenson.com/blog/pepsico-tostitos-super-bowl-2026.

### Latin America Billboard Awards
Artist relations for the Latin America Billboard Awards. Three performing artists. Backstage hospitality, run-of-show timing, riders, broadcast precision.

### Presidio Women's Golf Club (Founding Member)
Co-founded the women's club at Presidio Golf Course (West Coast's second-oldest course, San Francisco). 300+ tournaments executed across seven years. Built charter membership from zero to multiples of starting size. Operational philosophy at https://whitneystevenson.com/blog/presidio-golf-300-tournaments.

### Sunglasses Retail (Founder)
Founder of an entrepreneurial sunglasses retail venture with two San Francisco locations.

### Bodywork Practice
Practicing bodyworker — Facial Release and Access Consciousness — alongside event work.

## Signature Story: The Target Run

A breakout speaker walked on stage with no screen. The sales rep had forgotten the TV. Whitney drove to Target, came back with a TV, and the session went on. Nobody in the room knew anything had gone wrong. The story is shorthand for her operating philosophy: solutions over panic. Full essay at https://whitneystevenson.com/blog/the-target-run.

## How She Frames Her Work

Whitney's framing: hospitality > logistics. She believes the "white-glove" reputation isn't soft — it's the result of pre-built relationships with the people who can unblock you in 90 minutes. Calm under pressure isn't a personality trait; it's a practice. She measures her work by whether the audience experiences friction. They shouldn't.

## Roles She's a Fit For

- Event Marketing Manager / Senior Event Manager / Director of Events
- Field Marketing Manager (B2B technology focus)
- Channel Marketing Manager (regional or international)
- Customer Marketing — Events
- Conference Manager / Trade Show Lead
- Brand Activation Producer
- Event Operations Lead
- Hospitality Lead at conferences or executive programs

## What She's Looking For

A full-time role at a mission-driven company where the work nurtures a career rather than fills a slot. Open to starting in event coordination if the team is right. Strong preference for companies that take execution seriously and measure their events against revenue impact.
